description: This file defines the NodeRevisionRevertTranslationForm class, which provides a form for reverting a specific translation of a node revision in Drupal. It manages form creation, user prompts, and revision preparation for translation reversion.

classes.name: NodeRevisionRevertTranslationForm
classes.description: A form class for reverting a node's translation to a previous revision in Drupal.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question for reverting a translation.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the form description, empty in this case.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, including a checkbox for reverting shared content among translations.

methods.name: prepareRevertedRevision
methods.description: Prepares and creates a reverted revision of the translation.
